subject: Invoice cadence & delivery preference for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.ai>, accounts-payable@evergreen.ai
Cc: J. Reed <j.reed@evergreen.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice cadence & delivery preference for Redwood pilot

Hi Marta / AP team,

Thanks again for kicking off the Redwood pilot — excited to get things running. I wanted to confirm how Evergreen prefers to receive invoices so our billing ops can align before the first invoice goes out next month. Two quick options we usually offer:

- Portal push (Redwood Console / AP archive) + optional email PDF copies to accounts-payable@evergreen.ai
- SFTP/EDI delivery to your AP system (we can provision credentials) with email notification only

A couple of items we need to confirm from your side so the invoices match your processing rules:
- Do you require a PO number present on the invoice? If so, is it mandatory for payment?
- Preferred remit-to address (physical or bank remittance instructions)?
- VAT/Tax ID to include on the invoice header (if applicable) — please provide full number and entity name.
- Any invoice file format preference (PDF only, XML/UBL, or both)?

I attached our short AP intake form to speed this up. If email copies are fine, we can send a PDF to accounts-payable@evergreen.ai and also keep the same document in the portal for your team. Alternatively we can prioritize SFTP and stop sending email attachments.

Next steps I propose after you confirm: 1) we draft the first sample invoice and share it for sign-off, 2) we enable the chosen delivery method, 3) first actual invoice issues on the agreed date.

Appreciate a quick note on the preferences and the best billing contact (name & email).

Thanks,

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Evergreen_AP_Request_Form.pdf
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: J. Reed <j.reed@evergreen.ai>, accounts-payable@evergreen.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & delivery preference for Redwood pilot

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the clear options. Quick answers from AP: we prefer to receive a PDF copy by email to accounts-payable@evergreen.ai AND have the invoice pushed into a portal for our archive. We are also open to SFTP for integration, but that requires an internal request — if you support SFTP, send the onboarding checklist and we will route for approval.

Details:
- PO: Yes, PO number is required for our ERP to match and pay. If a PO is not present payment will be delayed.
- VAT/Tax: Evergreen AI US entity is not VAT-registered; however, for any EU invoicing (if applicable) we will provide the VAT ID. For US invoices please include the tax classification line as "Tax: 0%" when applicable.
- Remittance: Please use this remit email for check/EFT processing: ap-payments@evergreen.ai. Physical remit address attached in our W9.
- Format: PDF is preferred; if you can also provide a machine-readable line (simple XML/CSV) with fields (invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_items, total) that would help our AR team.

I attached our W9. Our procurement lead (J. Reed) is cc'd for the PO flow — contact him if you need a sample PO to validate formatting.

Marta

--
Marta Lopez
AP Manager, Evergreen AI
Attachment: Evergreen_W9.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & delivery preference for Redwood pilot

On Sat, Jul 14, 2028 at 9:12 AM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Marta / AP team,
> 
> Thanks again for kicking off the Redwood pilot — excited to get things running. I wanted to confirm how Evergreen prefers to receive invoices so our billing ops can align before the first invoice goes out next month.

Hi Marta, thanks for the fast reply and the W9. We're happy to support the PDF-email + portal archive approach and can optionally enable SFTP once you raise the internal request.

Proposed Redwood defaults for Evergreen (please confirm):
- Delivery: Portal push + PDF copy to accounts-payable@evergreen.ai on invoice issue date.
- PO handling: invoice will include a dedicated PO field; invoices received without a PO will be flagged and held for manual review (we'll surface this in the invoice metadata).
- Invoice numbering: RDW-EVG-YYYYMM-XXXX (sample attached as invoice_sample_202807.pdf).
- Tax line: include tax-breakdown row; for US entity show 0% where applicable and include W9 reference.
- Remittance & payment instructions: include ap-payments@evergreen.ai as remit-to contact and display your remit address per W9.

Action items:
1) Camila to confirm final delivery date for the first invoice (we recommend the 1st of the month after pilot usage closes).
2) Marta/J. Reed to provide a sample PO format or one sample PO to test matching.
3) Laura to validate VAT/tax wording and XML schema (Laura: can you confirm we will expose a simple CSV/XML export with the fields Marta requested?).

If that all looks good we'll schedule the sample invoice for sign-off by Friday.

Thanks,
Ben
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: invoice_sample_202807.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invoice cadence & delivery preference for Redwood pilot

Forwarding our thread — hi Marta, quick note from Billing/Tax: we will include a VAT/Tax ID header if you provide one for EU entities; for the US invoices we will include the tax breakdown line with 0% per your request and attach the W9 reference.

On SFTP: we can provision an SFTP account for Evergreen and support a nightly push of invoice CSVs if your internal team approves. To proceed with SFTP we need: desired hostname (or we can provide one), preferred auth (username/password vs key-based), and the sample PO file you mentioned.

Proposed timeline once we have the PO sample and delivery confirmation:
- Day 0: Receive PO sample + SFTP preference (if any).
- Day 1-2: Configure portal delivery and SFTP sandbox (if requested).
- Day 3: Generate sample invoice and CSV; send to accounts-payable@evergreen.ai for sign-off.
- Day 7: Go-live first production invoice send.

Next steps for Marta / AP: please confirm preferred go-live invoice date and attach one sample PO. If SFTP is wanted, indicate key-based auth and we'll send the onboarding checklist.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sftp_onboarding_checklist.xlsx
